fusions.name: Cinder Fling
fusions.desc: Flings a spadeful of live coals in a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 4 fire damage with a 50% chance to set each enemy [Burning] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow Match
fusions.desc: Plunges the glowing blade into the target, dealing 12 damage and setting it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Coal Trench
fusions.desc: Digs a trench 5 tiles long and fills it with coals for 6 seconds. Anything that crosses it is set [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Bellows Work
fusions.desc: Every time you use an ability, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per stack (36% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
